episodes.summaryZh:
伊德被莉莉丝抚养长大，听从莉莉丝的命令杀害了许多人。
莉莉丝声称一切都是为了救赎，伊德对此深信不疑。
然而，莉莉丝却扬言要牺牲这片天空、牺牲一切。
直到最后，伊德都希望莉莉丝能回心转意，
但事与愿违，二人最终决裂。
episodes.summaryEn:
Lilith meant everything to Id. She raised him—told him
who to cut down. He truly believed it was all for the sake
of bringing salvation until it came out that she intended
to sacrifice Zegagrande in its entirety. Id pleaded with
her to the very end to change her mind. She refused, and
that sealed her fate.

episodes.summaryZh:
伊德在过去的达利之灾中失去了故乡和家人。
莉莉丝出现在神情恍惚的伊德面前救了他一命，
自此成为了他的养母。
伊德一心想为母亲分忧，
于是拼命修炼，最终被提拔为教团的将军。
episodes.summaryEn:
Fifteen years ago, Id lost his home and family in
the Dahli disaster. He was found wandering alone
by Lilith, and she took the young boy in as her own.
Ever grateful to his adoptive mother, he poured his
heart and soul into being her sword. In time, he
became an Aviaeth general.

episodes.summaryZh:
莉莉丝解除了伊德的封印，
令伊德化身成为破坏神巴哈姆特·异型。
伊德因等人拼命的呼唤恢复了神智，
并和一起将异型逼回了异空间。
但罗兰却为了保护他们而牺牲自己，被困在了异空间。
伊德来到弗尔卡，决意接手他的便利屋。
这是为了报答罗兰的牺牲，也是为了给自己赎罪。
episodes.summaryEn:
A fierce battle between Bahamut Versa, whom Lilith
had sealed inside Id, erupted in the sky. While battling
the powerful dragon, the crew helped Id regain his
senses. Together with , he banished
Bahamut to an alternate dimension, though this also
trapped the both of them. Rolan rescued them by
swapping places. To repay Rolan for his sacrifice and
atone for his sins, Id returns to Folca to take over as
Mr. Fix It in Rolan's absence.

episodes.summaryZh:
伊德和等人一起为便利屋的事奔走忙碌时，
接到了一个委托。
有一个为因教团袭击希德霍姆而失去家园的人准备的移居计划，
委托内容是请他们进行护卫。
为了赎罪，伊德决定和其他人一起承接委托。
episodes.summaryEn:
Id and the crew are hard at work running errands
to improve Id's reputation when they receive a
request from Seedhollow. The city wants to relocate
families that lost their homes to Avia's assault and
would like a guard detail. Id thinks this job can help
him atone.

episodes.summaryZh:
伊德和一起帮助流离失所的人们迁往天培尔。
在这过程中，他遇到了一位名叫希洛尔的哈文族少女。
少女认出伊德曾是阿维亚教团的一员，
参与过针对希德霍姆的袭击行动。
这时，一行人得到哥布林出现的消息，于是赶往事发地。
在战斗中好不容易找到了失踪的希洛尔，但伊德却独自离开了。
episodes.summaryEn:
Id and the crew help escort displaced families to
Tempeal. One of the new settlers is a Harvin girl named
Shirolu who hates Id for what Avia did to her home.
Goblins suddenly attack the settlement, and Shirolu
gets lost in the chaos. Id hurries off to find her.

episodes.summaryZh:
哥布林袭击发生后第二天。
希洛尔找到了伊德，感谢他救了自己。
出于负罪感，伊德问希洛尔有没有什么他帮得上忙的地方，
得到的却是希洛尔悲痛的答复——“失去的东西已经回不来了”。
伊德深刻认识到自己犯下的罪孽有多深重。
episodes.summaryEn:
The day after the goblin attack, Shirolu visits Id to thank
him for saving her. He asks if there's anyway he can
make amends, to which the girl retorts that he can't
bring back the dead. The weight of his mistakes weighs
even heavier on him.

episodes.summaryZh:
希洛尔知道伊德曾参与袭击希德霍姆。
察觉此事的等人很担心伊德，
而伊德却仍想实现希洛尔他们的心愿。
episodes.summaryEn:
, Lyria, and Vyrn sense something is troubling
Id. He tells them Shirolu knows he was part of Avia. This
worries the crew, but Id is only focused on providing the
girl and the settlers with whatever they ask for.

episodes.summaryZh:
岛民看向伊德的眼神发生了巨大的转变，
似乎都对伊德抱有明显的敌意。
他们不仅不和他说话，甚至都不愿靠近他。
很明显，伊德的过去已经暴露。
等人纷纷为伊德辩解，
但伊德却接受了现状，认为这是自己理应背负的罪孽。
episodes.summaryEn:
Day by day, the settlers grow colder toward Id. It seems
his past involvement with Avia has come to light. The
crew attempt to rationalize the reasons behind his
misdeeds, but Id remains steadfast in bearing
responsibility.

episodes.summaryZh:
希洛尔来找伊德道歉，
说他们前几天的对话被村里的人听到了。
但伊德不明白她为什么要道歉，
并认为那些谴责的眼神是自己应受的惩罚。
这时，警钟再次响起，运输队遭到哥布林袭击的消息传来。
伊德立刻和等人一起赶赴事发地进行救援。
一行人虽然及时救下了运输队，
却发现无人防守的村庄正遭受哥布林袭击。
伊德独自赶往村庄战斗。
望着独自一人保护村庄的伊德，
希洛尔忍不住大喊：“加油——”
episodes.summaryEn:
Shirolu apologizes to Id for exposing his past to the
others. Id replies that he deserves the scorn of the
people he hurt. Suddenly the alarm bells ring: a supply
convoy is being attacked by goblins. Id and the crew
leave the village and save the convoy just in time, but
a second goblin force has invaded the settlement. Id
rushes back to fight the goblins alone. Shouts of
encouragement come from an unlikely ally: Shirolu.

episodes.summaryZh:
自哥布林的第二次袭击已经过去一晚，
伊德和移居者们有了好好谈一谈的机会。
移居者们接纳了伊德，
并表示虽然还没原谅教团袭击希德霍姆的事，
但也无法指责拼上性命保护他们的伊德。
希洛尔则表示虽然村庄附近仍很危险，
但只要有擅长清剿魔物的便利屋在就没有问题。
episodes.summaryEn:
The morning after the goblin attack, an open
discussion is held between Id and the settlers. Avia's
assault on their home of Seedhollow can never be
undone, but they also acknowledge that Id risked his
life to save them from goblins, thus earning their trust.
In light of the recent goblin attacks, concerns arise
over the safety of the settlement, but Shirolu quickly
pipes in that everything will work out because they
have Mr. Fix It.

episodes.summaryZh:
掌管天空的星晶兽圣德芬——
他以"天司"的身份降生，
并仰慕着创造他的天司长路西菲尔。
与此同时，他也时常为自己
没有存在意义而感到烦恼。
某日，他得知自己不过是路西菲尔的替代品，
对路西菲尔的情感就此彻底逆转。
堕天司叛乱之际，他借机公然造反。
其暴行实则出于他对路西菲尔的复杂情感。
episodes.summaryEn:
The archangels were primal beasts led by Supreme
Primarch Lucifer to regulate the Sky Realm. Unlike
all the other archangels, Sandalphon was created
by Lucifer but never given a role, causing the
archangel to question his reason for existing.
When Sandalphon discovered he was nothing more
than Lucifer's spare, he joined the fallen angels
in a rebellion against their creators. Ever since
then, Sandalphon has struggled with his complex
relationship with Lucifer.

episodes.summaryZh:
圣德芬之所以选择叛变，
是因为他想得到路西菲尔的关注。
但路西菲尔却说一切责任皆在自己，
并让受伤的圣德芬就此陷入长眠。
时光流转，圣德芬再次醒来时，
路西菲尔已化作了遗骸。
圣德芬从他最后留下的信息中
得知了他的真实想法，
于是决心继承天司长的遗志。
episodes.summaryEn:
Sandalphon nearly doomed the Sky Realm partly as a
ploy to force Lucifer to punish him, thereby
acknowledging his existence. Instead, Lucifer
accepted full responsibility for Sandalphon's sins
and placed him in a deep sleep. When Sandalphon
awoke from his long slumber, he discovered that
Lucifer had been murdered. With his final breath,
Lucifer had left a heartfelt message for Sandalphon
and bequeathed his supreme primarch powers to the
archangel.

episodes.summaryZh:
圣德芬继承天司长的力量后，
与等人齐心协力，
共同对抗企图让终焉降临的星之民路西法。
虽然一行人面对其压倒性的力量身陷困境，
但圣德芬所激发出的十二羽翼之力
带着众人的希望，最终击败了路西法。
圣德芬也在激战过后与路西菲尔重逢。
为了继承路西菲尔的遗志，圣德芬将继续前行——
episodes.summaryEn:
As the new supreme primarch, Sandalphon fought
alongside 's crew to stop the Astral
Lucilius from destroying the world. All hope seemed
lost until Sandalphon manifested twelve wings,
which bore the resolve of him and the skydwellers,
and at long last, Lucilius was defeated. After the
battle, Sandalphon briefly reunited with Lucifer
in a place without time. Before returning once
more to reality, Sandalphon reaffirmed his vow to
continue Lucifer's work.

episodes.summaryZh:
圣德芬来到了泽卡·格兰迪空域，
与等人共同行动。
一天，在城里偶然见到的一幅画
让他产生了担忧——
该空域的风元素或许发生了紊乱。
四大元素的紊乱可能导致岛屿崩坏坠毁。
为了进一步调查，一行人前往与风元素
关系密切的星晶兽胡拉坎的所在之处。
episodes.summaryEn:
Sandalphon arrives in Zegagrande to visit the
crew. While exploring Folca, a scenic painting of
Zegagrande's sky catches his eye; something about
the artwork suggests to him that the equilibrium
of the tetra-elements could be eroding. The crew
heads to Tempeal to investigate the condition of
the wind element.

episodes.summaryZh:
圣德芬一行来到了荣风祭坛。
制服失控的星晶兽胡拉坎后，
罗兰推测聚集于星神的 "信仰之力"减少
是导致星晶兽异常的原因。
圣德芬则表示如果胡拉坎的力量继续流失，
泽卡的风元素将不再稳定，
最终可能导致该空域的岛屿坠毁。
一行人为了阻止最坏的情况发生，
决定前往其他岛屿，
重新树立民众对星晶兽的信仰——
episodes.summaryEn:
At Halewind Altar, the crew is forced to subdue a
berserk Furycane. Rolan believes waning faith in
the primeval gods is creating abnormal conditions.
According to Sandalphon, as Furycane's power
declines, the wind element in Zegagrande will grow
unstable, causing islands to fall. The crew races
to the next island, hoping to mend the connection
between primals and skydwellers.

episodes.summaryZh:
一行人来到隆塔涅岛，伊丝特莉亚斯告诉他们
涅咎里斯灵峰的冰川已经开始融化。
一行人认为这是元素失衡的征兆。
考虑到司掌“隔绝”的玛纳加尔姆其特性，
他们决定再次关闭特尔达姆宫的大门，
尝试通过提高神秘性令“信仰之力”重新汇聚。
episodes.summaryEn:
Waning faith in Managarmr seems to be disrupting
the water element, causing parts of Mt. Neigelith
to thaw. Together with Historiath, the crew seals
Managarmr—the primal of sequestration—behind
Tredame Sanctum's doors in an attempt to revitalize
the primeval god's mystique among the people.

episodes.summaryZh:
一行人接着来到了达利岛。
在司掌“镇守”的艾卡利翁庇佑下，
这里的人们曾经过着和平安宁的生活。
但如今这片沙漠中再无岛民，
更无从收集人们的“信仰之力”……
这时，得知情况的扎斯巴开展了一项计划——
他要利用这片土地埋藏着的"宝藏"
吸引人们前来寻宝。
这是拥有情报这一利器的扎斯巴家族才能做到的——
一行人不禁对此赞叹不已。
episodes.summaryEn:
Excavallion was once revered for both blessing
Dahli's land and sheltering its people. Considering
the desert landscape now, however, bringing people
back to Dahli will be a hard sell. Luckily, Zathba
has set up a treasure-hunting venture on Dahli—
hopefully sowing the seeds of growth.

episodes.summaryZh:
下一站是被封锁的岛屿枫达慕。
一行人在此处遭遇的伏尔甘博拉
正是因其受人们畏惧
才化为了畏惧的化身。
此时，罗兰和岛民一同赶来，
提议在岛上设立观测站并进行祷告。
罗兰表示要从让人们正确认识伏尔甘博拉开始，
逐步实现枫达慕的稳定。
事情算是有了眉目，但一行人还未来得及喘口气
就听说了莉莉丝还活着的消息并大为震惊。
episodes.summaryEn:
Vulkan Bolla's current form manifested as a result
of the constant "dread" that people couldn't let
go of. Rolan and the islanders decide to build an
observatory on Phondam that will double as a spot
for worship. With four elements accounted for, the
situation seems under control until Rolan reveals
that Lilith may still be alive.

episodes.summaryZh:
圣德芬到达巴约塔后
察觉到各地出现的元素异常都汇聚于此。
这时，莉莉丝的声音传入一行人的耳中。
众人合力打开次元之门，
进入了疑似莉莉丝藏身的异次元……
在那里等待着他们的是还在盲目听从
造物主遗留之声的安格拉·曼纽。
一番激战过后，一行人封印了安格拉·曼纽。
至此，四大元素紊乱引发的异常事件
终于得以解决。
episodes.summaryEn:
Sandalphon had felt currents of dissonance on each
of the islands, which seemingly converge at Vayoi's
summit. The crew hears Lilith's voice at the peak,
so they open a dimensional gate to confront her.
However, Lilith is truly gone—it's actually Angra
Mainyu, obeying Lilith's lingering commands. The
crew defeats and seals the primal, which should
help the future stability of the tetra-elements.

episodes.summaryZh:
事件告一段落后——
泽卡各岛尝试收集“信仰之力”的计划
似乎正在有条不紊地进行中。
人的潜能是无限的，终有一天，
即使没有天司的帮助，他们也将克服所有困难。
想到这一点，圣德芬在略感寂寥之余，
再次为这片天空的安宁献上了祈祷。
episodes.summaryEn:
Sandalphon revisits each island and observes
that the various plans to rebuild faith in the
primals appear to be progressing smoothly. He
muses that the skydwellers' infinite potential
will allow them to overcome anything, rendering
the archangels' aid redundant over time. But until
that bittersweet parting arrives, he'll continue
to protect the skies.

episodes.summaryZh:
集结十位使用不同武器全空最强之人的骑空团——“十天众”。
希耶提担任该团的统领，而其创立的理由
是希望凭借最强的力量来抑制纷争。
实现理想的道路并非一帆风顺，
但希耶提对此依旧感到知足。
他认为，光是集结了世界最强就足够有意思了。
episodes.summaryEn:
Seofon assembled ten of the strongest warriors in
their weapon class to form the Eternals. He
reasoned that the mere presence of an all-powerful
skyfaring crew would be enough to stop conflict
before it started, though he also admits he
gathered ultimate fighters just for the fun of it.
In practice, the philosophy of strength as a
deterrent hasn't always panned out, but as far as
Seofon is concerned, the Eternals have been a
success.

episodes.summaryZh:
通过由“涯”传来的声音，
希耶提得知了伊德的存在——
伊德曾化身为破坏之龙，几近摧毁空之世界。
身为十天众，希耶提无法对这片天空的威胁袖手旁观。
“不过，伊德现在是的伙伴。
你的选择可能会导致与他们产生冲突哦？”
尽管希耶提因乌诺的话语而产生动摇，
却还是决定前往泽卡·格兰迪空域
去探一探伊德的底细。
episodes.summaryEn:
A voice echoing from the "boundary" alerts Seofon
to Id's existence, declaring that Id has the
potential to destroy the skies. Upon discussing
this revelation with Anre, the elder Eternal
reveals that Id is 's friend, and Seofon
may face difficult choices ahead. Seofon heads for
Zegagrande to ascertain the threat for himself.

episodes.summaryZh:
希耶提本打算独自一人踏上泽卡·格兰迪空域之旅，
却收到了来自索恩的结伴前行的请求。
“我得好好看着你，
免得你又做出什么惹大家讨厌你的事。”
希耶提因索恩的话语哑口无言，
但最终乐观地归结为这是索恩在担心自己，
为索恩的同行感到欣喜。
episodes.summaryEn:
Seofon is thrilled to hear that Tweyen is coming
with him to Zegagrande, only to have his pride
wounded when she explains it's to keep him from
doing anything foolish. Nevertheless, Seofon is
grateful for the company, choosing to believe this
is Tweyen's way of showing concern for him.

episodes.summaryZh:
希耶提抵达泽卡并与等人会合。
他为自己未能协力抵抗莉莉丝的威胁之事表示抱歉，
并认识了伊德。
希耶提与伊德握手问候的时候
察觉到伊德有一股空前的力量，
便对其起了戒备之心。
episodes.summaryEn:
Seofon reunites with  and the crew in
Zegagrande and apologies for not being on hand to
help defeat Lilith. He's introduced to Id, and
upon shaking the man's hand, feels a surge of
power he's never felt before. Seofon's apprehension
intensifies.

episodes.summaryZh:
希耶提以帮忙张罗便利屋之名留在了弗尔卡，
打算借此观察伊德。
在这期间，他们收到凶讯，
说有强敌即将进犯某个村落。
希耶提计上心头，
决定与伊德二人先行前往事发地。
在合力击退魔物的过程中，
希耶提找到了亲眼见证伊德体内那股强大力量的机会。
并且，希耶提也深刻地意识到了
伊德这一存在的威胁。
episodes.summaryEn:
Seofon helps with requests around Folca in order
to observe Id. One day, a settlement comes under
attack from powerful monsters. Seofon suggests
that he and Id head out first to fight the foes,
which would also give him an excuse to witness
Id's true strength. As the fights unfold, Seofon's
fears are all but confirmed.

episodes.summaryZh:
伊德拥有的力量或将威胁到整个世界。
身为十天众，必须尽早将其铲除——
面对希耶提的主张，索恩表示反对。
正如曾经团员们入伙时那样，
伊德兴许也能做得很好。
在今后的旅途中，抑或是空之世界，
也许将会需要伊德的力量……
因此，还需要一些时日对伊德进行观察。
希耶提承认了索恩话中的道理，
于是改变主意，决定对伊德一事暂且观望。
episodes.summaryEn:
Having concluded that Id's power poses a risk to
the world's stability, Seofon argues with Tweyen
that it's their duty as Eternals to eliminate him.
Tweyen counters that Id needs more time to prove
himself, reminding Seofon that other problem cases
have gone on to become 's greatest
allies. Seofon accepts Tweyen's opinion and agrees
to observe Id for a bit longer.

episodes.summaryZh:
希耶提在弗尔卡对伊德进行了调查，
结果只发现了伊德广受赞誉这一事实。
不过，也有一件事让人心生顾虑。
据一名曾受伊德搭救的商人所言，
其曾亲眼见过伊德那股强大力量并对此感到不安。
足以让他人心生畏惧的力量
稍有不慎就有可能在空之世界招致动乱。
这是令人担忧的危险之一。
episodes.summaryEn:
Seofon asks the Folca locals about Id and learns
that he's nearly universally praised. However, a
merchant whom Id had rescued from monsters
expressed how terrified she'd been of his brutal
power. People are easily afraid of the unknown—
fears that turn rampant can destabilize the Sky
Realm.

episodes.summaryZh:
希耶提内心一直很纠结，不知是否应当相信伊德。
恰逢此时，“涯”中又传来了声音。
那是来自另一个世界的“希耶提”的声音。
“他”让希耶提看了伊德在获得创世与破坏之力后
失控的未来，迫使他作出决定。
“不拘泥于私情的最佳选择，
有时并不能获得他人的理解”——
希耶提回想起乌诺的话语，
决定不再犹豫，定要除掉伊德。
episodes.summaryEn:
As Seofon wrestles with what to do with Id, the
voice from the boundary—a Seofon from a different
timeline—warns that Id will threaten the world if
he obtains the power of creation to complement his
dragon powers. Anre's premonition about Seofon
making difficult choices has come true; Seofon
decides he has to eliminate Id.

episodes.summaryZh:
希耶提与伊德，他们各自拥有无法退让的理由。
二人展开了决斗。
激战过后，伊德跪倒在地，
随后仍重新站起，意欲提剑再战。
正当二人即将再次交锋之际，
索恩与等人赶到。
希耶提本欲不顾伙伴的劝说
将战斗进行到底，
但被竭尽全力的诉说所打动，
最终收起了剑。
episodes.summaryEn:
A fierce duel erupts between Seofon and Id, each
man fighting for their lives and motives. Id
appears defeated, but he stands up for one final
attack. Before either can land the killing blow,
Tweyen, , and the crew step in. It takes
a harsh rebuke from  before Seofon
finally relents and sheathes his sword.

episodes.summaryZh:
希耶提为自己挑起决斗一事向伊德道歉。
伊德对希耶提的决定表示理解，
并回应称自己希望将力量用于正道。
“拥有强大力量之人，也需要承担相应的责任——”
尽管伊德的想法或许与希耶提的这一理念不同，
但他也有着相同的觉悟。
希耶提重新说服自己——
既然如此，自己收起剑也一定是有其意义的。
episodes.summaryEn:
Id accepts Seofon's apology for trying to kill him.
The young man understands Seofon's motive, and he
recognizes the risks associated with his power,
but he's determined to use it for good. Although
their philosophies may differ, both men are aware
of the great responsibility that comes with great
power. Seofon doesn't completely trust Id yet, but
he's willing to take a chance on him.

episodes.titleEn: Like a Fish out of Water

episodes.summaryZh:
索恩作为猎人的才能出类拔萃。
她对偏僻的乡间生活感到厌倦，独自来到了城里。
她在城中的日子顺风顺水。袭人猛兽出没之时，
索恩也曾凭擅长的箭术将其击毙，赢得一片喝彩……
殊不知城乡之间的常识有别，
她当场对毙命的猛兽进行解剖，
令目睹这一不寻常之事的城里人纷纷侧目。
他们透露出的是看待异常之人时的“目光”——
索恩失去了自己的安身之所，
深深体会到了孤独的滋味。
episodes.summaryEn:
Blessed with first-class hunting skills, Tweyen
felt restricted by her country lifestyle, so she
moved to the city for a new start. One day, Tweyen
felled a beast that had invaded the city. Unaware
of the societal norms of her current home, she
began dressing the kill in public, which drew
looks of horror and disgust from bystanders. This
was her first taste of ostracism, one that would
lead her down a path of solitude.

episodes.summaryZh:
索恩在旅途的过程中渐渐觉得，
这片天空中或许没有人的箭术能胜过自己。
另一方面，索恩也开始自嘲为“怪物”。
而产生这一想法的契机，便是她视作挚友的希尔瓦
在评价其招式时脱口而出“怪物的力量”一事。
自那以来，索恩开始与希尔瓦保持距离。
然而，她们又在的骑空团中重逢。
她们相互倾诉，解除了误会并重归于好。
索恩切实地感受到，自己并不孤独。
episodes.summaryEn:
As Tweyen continued to travel the skies, she
wondered if anyone could match her shooting
skills. Because of her monstrous abilities, she
came to cynically view herself as a monster, an
appraisal further exacerbated when Silva, her
supposed best friend, inadvertently called her
one. The two friends drifted apart, only to be
reunited by 's crew, and they both
reconciled. The solitary hunter would no longer
have to be alone anymore.

episodes.summaryZh:
在成为全空最强组织十天众的一员后，
索恩对组织成员间关系疏远一事感到不满。
某天，她得知希耶提打算
单独前往泽卡·格兰迪空域。
希耶提忠于自己身为十天众的使命，
但也经常为此背负了太多责任。
索恩无法对此视而不见，
提出要与希耶提一同前往。
episodes.summaryEn:
Tweyen had joined the Eternals in the hopes of
finding a fun group to hang out with, but sadly
for her, the Eternals aren't the sociable type.
After hearing that Seofon plans to go to Zegagrande,
Tweyen decides to accompany him. While she
respects his sense of justice, she knows it's better
to have someone around to keep his zeal in check.

episodes.summaryZh:
索恩在泽卡·格兰迪空域与等人成功会合，
并认识了伊德这名新的伙伴，
决定为他所经营的便利屋出一份力。
在与伊德相处的日子里，
她发现伊德正处于无尽的赎罪当中。
索恩因此感到了一丝的不安与危险。
episodes.summaryEn:
Once in Zegagrande, Tweyen is introduced to Id,
and she volunteers to help the handyman with Folca
requests. During her time working with Id, she
comes to see him as a young man tormented by
unrelenting guilt, and that worries her.

episodes.summaryZh:
伊德拥有的力量过于危险。
身为十天众，必须尽早将其铲除——
与伊德结伴同行后，希耶提表达了这样的主张。
对此，索恩表示反对，认为现在下定论还为时尚早。
不久，众人接到了紧急救援的委托。
索恩与伊德一同前往，为商人提供护卫。
在那里，商人目睹了伊德变身后的模样，
对其惊人的破坏之力感到恐惧……
而索恩只能在一旁对她进行安抚。
episodes.summaryEn:
Seofon tries to convince Tweyen that they need to
silence Id before he becomes an unstoppable force,
but Tweyen persuades Seofon to give Id more time.
Later, Tweyen and Id rescue a merchant from
monsters. Id had transformed into his dragonform
during the fight, and his brute power terrified
the merchant so greatly that she spoke ill of the
rescuer.

episodes.summaryZh:
索恩与伊德一同返回了弗尔卡。
刚一抵达，伊德就被一群热情的群众围住。
他在不知所措的同时也予以了回应。
没有人把伊德当作怪物而畏惧，
这份情感的联系是伊德通过自身努力赢得的。
但另一方面，索恩也无法完全忽视
伊德体内力量的威胁。
她将注意力转向了曾经的灾祸之地——达利岛，
试图从中看清伊德力量的本质。
episodes.summaryEn:
When Tweyen and Id pull into Folca's port, a large
crowd of townspeople is on hand to welcome Id
home. Id has earned his place in Folca, and not a
single person is afraid of his dragon counterpart.
Nevertheless, Tweyen knows Id's power has the
potential to threaten the world. She travels to
Dahli Island in a bid to better understand his
power.

episodes.summaryZh:
“达利之灾”的事发地——达利岛。
索恩目睹十五年前被毁的废墟
思绪万千之时，伊德叫住了她。
伊德说，达利岛上有他的故乡，
他时常会造访这里祭奠死者的魂灵。
十五年前的灾祸源于
被封印于伊德体内的破坏之龙——
身为十天众的一员，索恩很清楚
自己不该放任与这样的力量性质相同的存在。
索恩心中的纠葛仍未解开。
episodes.summaryEn:
Tweyen gazes out at the ruins of Dahli, alone with
her thoughts until Id, who has come to pay
respects to the fallen of his hometown, appears.
He explains to her that the Dahli Catastrophe
occurred as a result of Versa being sealed within
him. Although Tweyen sympathizes with Id's plight,
she still has to decide what to do about him.

episodes.summaryZh:
索恩在伊德身上看到了自己孤身一人时的影子。
但伊德的身边有许多人支持着他，
索恩认为伊德并不会重蹈自己的覆辙。
想到这里，索恩向伊德提问——
倘若出现了强敌，不得不将自身
完全托付给龙的力量时，伊德会如何选择。
“如果那里有我必须要保护的对象，我不会犹豫。”
听到伊德的回答，
索恩终于找到了心中的答案。
episodes.summaryEn:
While Id's situation is similar to the isolation
Tweyen experienced when she first set out on her
own, Id has a vast support system she never did.
Thanks to that, Tweyen is confident he won't go
down the wrong path. When Id is asked if he'd use
his power against the ultimate evil, he replies
he'd put his life on the line to save people. With
that answer, Tweyen knows what she has to do.

episodes.summaryZh:
索恩收到了来自伽兰查的战书。
赶赴伽兰查所在的希德霍姆城后，
还没等索恩说上几句，战斗便不由分说地打响了。
中途，玛琪拉菲菈也参与了进来。
尽管战况激烈，索恩还是击退了二人。
原来，他们是为了从十天众手中
保护他们视为弟弟的伊德。
索恩向二人解释自己同样打算保护伊德，
终于让他们放下了戒心。
episodes.summaryEn:
Tweyen is challenged to a duel by Gallanza at
Seedhollow Castle. She tries to reason with him
but is forced to fight when Gallanza won't budge.
The battle is fierce, made worse by Maglielle
joining the fray, but Tweyen prevails against the
pair. They'd only been trying to protect Id, who
they view as a little brother. When Tweyen
explains she's on their side, they finally back
down.

episodes.summaryZh:
索恩向道出事情的原委后，
便火速赶往希耶提与伊德所前往的飞龙之谷。
当她抵达目的地时，
二人正展开一场殊死较量。
为了制止纷争，索恩将箭矢射向了二人中间。
最终，希耶提收起了剑，事态得以平息。
episodes.summaryEn:
Tweyen reports her findings to . They
then learn that Seofon and Id were last seen
heading out into Ainsteddo Archipelago. Tweyen
spots the two in Skywyrm Valley, embroiled in a
fight to the death. She fires an arrow between the
two, stopping the fight and allowing the crew to
resolve the matter.

episodes.summaryZh:
年轻时的伽兰查给铁匠出了一个天大的难题——
打造既是最强之矛又是最强之盾的武具。
面对如此荒谬的要求，铁匠十分为难。
然而在伽兰查“凡事都要先尝试”的催促下，
铁匠也只能一遍又一遍地挥舞锻锤……
放弃思考后的本能驱使下，
铁匠终于打造出了最强的武具。
伽兰查拿到心仪的武具后对其赞不绝口。
episodes.summaryEn:
An uncompromising Gallanza burdens a Folcan smithy
with an impossible work order: He wants the strongest
spear and shield, forged as a single package.
Despite the absurdity of the request, the blacksmith
toils away at the furnace. Finally—after having
entered what appeared to be a delirious state—the
smith produces the mightiest spear, and one very
satisfied customer.

episodes.summaryZh:
正当伽兰查称霸泽卡各地的比武大赛后
为没有敌手而担忧之时，
引领星旅之室阿维亚的神秘女性莉莉丝出现在其面前。
面对实力远在自己之上的莉莉丝，
战栗的伽兰查内心却激动无比。
得知莉莉丝追求乐土的路上可能会遇到更加强大的敌人，
得知自己可能因此邂逅未知的“死战”，
伽兰查决心加入星旅之室。
episodes.summaryEn:
Crowned champion of every fighting tournament in
Zega, Gallanza laments his loneliness at the top
until a mysterious woman named Lilith appears
before him. With equal parts trepidation and elation,
he realizes that her strength eclipses his own.
Drawn to Lilith's promise of stronger opponents to
challenge if he allies himself with her Pilgrims of
Avia, Gallanza eagerly accepts, jumping at the
chance for more deathmatches.

episodes.summaryZh:
希德霍姆城被攻陷后，
伊德望着空中悬停的巴约塔，
向一同逃出的伽兰查道出了真相——
莉莉丝为了返回星之世界而不惜毁灭空之世界。
尽管伽兰查纯粹是为了与强者决一死战才加入星旅之室，
可一路走来也有了仰慕自己的部下。
为了让白狼兵团的战友们今后能在空之世界有容身之处，
伽兰查决定不再追随莉莉丝。
episodes.summaryEn:
The Pillar of Vayoi rises in the sky as Seedhollow
Castle falls. Id, having escaped the castle with
Gallanza, reveals Lilith's plan to sacrifice Zega
to open a gate to the Astral Realm. Gallanza had
only joined Avia to satisfy his own desire for
combat, but now that the futures of the brothers-
in-arms he's been blessed with are jeopardized,
he swears a reckoning with Lilith.

episodes.summaryZh:
正当伽兰查在弗尔卡给伊德的便利屋帮忙时，
原白狼兵团的卢克带来了一个意想不到的消息——
似乎有人打着白狼兵团的旗号在各地作乱，
搅得岛民们不得安宁。
白狼兵团的部下们都是伽兰查亲爱的战友……
伽兰查不能袖手旁观。
episodes.summaryEn:
While helping Mr. Fix Id with his various jobs,
Gallanza receives startling news from ex-Silver
Wolf Rook. An unknown group is causing trouble for
islanders under the name of the Silver Wolf Corps.
If Gallanza's former comrades actually are
involved, then the ex-general cannot sit idly by.

episodes.summaryZh:
循着打着白狼兵团旗号的那伙人的踪迹，
伽兰查和卢克来到了达利遗迹群。
为了让负隅顽抗的部下们悔过自新，
伽兰查和卢克向其据点发起了突袭。
战斗中伽兰查得知，是原白狼兵团的阿瓦兰
在白狼兵团因教团变故而分崩离析后
收留并整编了无家可归的战友们。
episodes.summaryEn:
Gallanza and Rook head to the Dahli Relicbelt in
pursuit of the so-called Silver Wolf Corps. They
storm the group's outpost, discovering that its
members are indeed former Wolf Corps soldiers. As
Gallanza unleashes discipline through corporal
punishment, he learns that Reaper Avalan is
responsible for continuing the Corps after its
dissolution.

episodes.summaryZh:
伽兰查并没有强行向达利的小队逼问阿瓦兰的下落。
他为兵团分崩离析一事道歉后
正准备默默离去时，
被伽兰查感动的加西亚主动向卢克透露了阿瓦兰的下落。
episodes.summaryEn:
The defeated soldiers refuse to divulge Avalan's
whereabouts. To their surprise, Gallanza doesn't
force the issue—he simply apologizes for abandoning
the Corps and departs in silence. Touched by his
sincerity and integrity, Galcia reveals Avalan's
location to Rook.

episodes.summaryZh:
回去的路上，伽兰查回顾着往事。
曾经的白狼兵团并不只是服从命令的军队，
而是更像彼此之间有着深厚感情的家人。
与卢克和阿瓦兰他们一同度过的
那些艰苦又快乐的日子无可替代，
对于带领着余众的阿瓦兰来说亦是如此。
为此伽兰查暗暗下了决心——
一定要让阿瓦兰明白，那所谓的“教诲”
不过是莉莉丝为了一己私欲而编造的谎言。
episodes.summaryEn:
Gallanza reminisces on his time with the Silver
Wolf Corps, appreciating that they weren't merely
an arm of Lilith's army but a family with whom he
broke bread. Their days together were as joyous
as they were arduous; each moment was an
irreplaceable memory. Gallanza still counts Avalan
as one of his brothers, thus he swears to lift the
wool of Lilith's lies from the latter's eyes.

episodes.summaryZh:
得知伽兰查有意让阿瓦兰迷途知返，
卢克道出余众潜伏在巴约塔遗址处的消息。
面对担心落入陷阱的卢克，
伽兰查豪迈地大笑着表示趟陷阱也甚是有趣。
episodes.summaryEn:
Upon confirming Gallanza's intentions to make
Avalan see reason, Rook informs him that the main
body of the delinquent Corps is holed up on the
Pillar of Vayoi. He warns Gallanza that it may be
a trap, but Gallanza replies with his signature
boisterous laugh—"at least it'll be entertaining,"
roars the battle-loving warrior.

episodes.summaryZh:
阿瓦兰率众列阵在巴约塔遗址处等候。
伽兰查却并未进行任何劝说，
拿起长矛开口就是“决一死战”。
不善言辞的两人一番较量之后，
阿瓦兰还是败在伽兰查面前。
然而曾经的团长却收起长矛扶起了即将倒下的战友，
泪水也随之流下。
episodes.summaryEn:
Confronting Avalan at Vayoi, Gallanza challenges
the rogue leader to a deathmatch, understanding
that actions speak louder than words. The men
clash, and Avalan sinks to his knees in defeat.
Instead of executing Avalan, a tearful Gallanza
helps his brother-in-arms up to his feet.

episodes.summaryZh:
为了赎罪，阿瓦兰带领余众
来到希德霍姆的哨所投案自首。
望着走向城门的战友们的背影，
伽兰查一脸释然地表示，
待战友们归来之时，
他一定亲自准备好吃的接风洗尘。
episodes.summaryEn:
Avalan and the ex-Corps members who followed him
turn themselves in at Seedhollow to begin making
amends for their crimes. As the men are led off to
be imprisoned, Gallanza shouts words of support
and promises to treat them to the best rice balls
in the skies once they finish serving their time.

episodes.summaryZh:
刀剑本无情，承念刃方重——
刃重一族的传承之路上充满了苦难。
然而即使因莫须有之事遭受歧视甚至是迫害，
当代族长也仍秉承着刃重的骄傲，昂首挺胸。
episodes.summaryEn:
"Our blades shall sing; our stories made legend."
A long-standing clan spanning many generations,
the Sword Veil Fellowship's history is fraught
with discrimination and prejudice. But even as
their passage through the streets invites jeers
and distrusting eyes, their leader stands tall,
holding fast to the clan's honor.

episodes.summaryZh:
那年，玛琪拉菲菈带领着族人在迫害之下辗转逃亡。
正当玛琪拉菲菈在偏远之地的断崖边茫然若失之时，
引领星旅之室阿维亚的神秘女性帮助了刃重一族。
名为莉莉丝的女性称其在追寻乐土伊斯塔鲁西亚，
以期获得永恒的安宁。
玛琪拉菲菈也向往着那不再有迫害的世界，
便决心加入星旅之室。
episodes.summaryEn:
Having led her kin on a seemingly endless exodus
across the skydom to escape persecution, Maglielle
finally crumbles under the weight of responsibility.
But then came a lifeline; Lilith, shepherd of the
Pilgrims of Avia, invites the Veil to join Avia on
a journey to a paradise free of discrimination—
Estalucia. Maglielle accepts on behalf of the clan.

episodes.summaryZh:
希德霍姆城被攻陷后，
伊德望着空中悬停的巴约塔，
向一同逃出的玛琪拉菲菈道出了真相——
莉莉丝为了返回星之世界而不惜毁灭空之世界。
追寻众生平等而安宁的乐土的目标原来只是谎言，
失去希望的玛琪拉菲菈哑口无言。
可一路走来，玛琪拉菲菈在星旅之室
也有了伊德和伽兰查这两位至交。
为了今后也能与众人在空之世界有容身之处，
玛琪拉菲菈决定反抗莉莉丝。
episodes.summaryEn:
The Pillar of Vayoi rises in the sky as Seedhollow
Castle falls. Id, having escaped the castle with
Maglielle, reveals Lilith's plan to sacrifice Zega
to open a gate to the Astral Realm. Maglielle is
left speechless, her dream of leading the Veil to
the promised land shattered. Even so, the bonds
she's forged with Id and Gallanza remain unbroken.
She swears a reckoning with Lilith so that she and
her found family may continue chasing their futures.

episodes.summaryZh:
因神兵传说而气氛火热的茶会上，
玛琪拉菲菈宣布她即将买到传说中的断钢圣剑，
却得知这把剑本应珍藏在菲德拉赫王国的宝库之中。
正当此时，万事屋谢洛赶来告知
她买的剑迟迟没能到货。
有着不祥的预感的一行
决定前去寻找中间商一探究竟。
episodes.summaryEn:
Maglielle hosts a tea party, regaling her guests
with rousing legends about her weapons. She proudly
announces her latest purchase order for Excalibur,
but Lancelot says the sword is heavily guarded in
Feendrache's vault and isn't for sale. Adding to
Maglielle's growing unease, Sierokarte suddenly
arrives with news that the order has been delayed.
Maglielle decides to go look for the missing blade.

episodes.summaryZh:
为了一探究竟，
一行前往涅咎里斯灵峰打听断钢剑的消息。
然而一路上的线索表明，
那把剑其实并不是断钢剑。
最终出于对这把传说级宝剑的好奇，
玛琪拉菲菈决定独自前往宝剑所在的弗尔卡。
episodes.summaryEn:
Maglielle and her tea party guests climb Mt.
Neigelith to question the sword seller about
Maglielle's order. They discover that, while the
sword isn't Excalibur, it is still a blade of
legendary quality—making Maglielle more
determined than ever to get her hands on it.
She heads to Folca, this time alone, to find
the supplier.

episodes.summaryZh:
找到弗尔卡当地的铁匠后，
玛琪拉菲菈得知确实有这把传说级的宝剑。
为了找到这把宝剑，
玛琪拉菲菈激动地强行打听出了
打造这把宝剑的资深铁匠所在之处。
episodes.summaryEn:
The smithy in Folca confirms the existence of the
legendary sword Maglielle had ordered. Eager to
find the master bladesmith responsible for forging
her promised sword, she pesters the blacksmith for
his location.

episodes.summaryZh:
玛琪拉菲菈正准备前往飞龙之谷，
却得知往返那里的骑空艇因突如其来的风暴而停运。
于是为了一睹拥有“天空卫士”别称的宝剑，
玛琪拉菲菈决定用飞翔术只身前往。
不过为了以防万一，
她把记录着一族意志和回忆的笔记
交给了万事屋谢洛保管。
episodes.summaryEn:
Sudden savage winds have grounded all flights to
Skywyrm Valley where the blademaster lives. Fixated
on finding her sword, dubbed "Sentinel of the Sky,"
Maglielle decides to brave the winds and fly there
with her magic. She leaves a tome of the Veil's
history in Sierokarte's hands, in case the worst
should come to pass.

episodes.summaryZh:
抵达位于飞龙之谷的铁匠工坊后，
玛琪拉菲菈遇到了一位抱着剑的小女孩。
这位小女孩似乎就是她所要找的铁匠的孩子，
而其怀里的剑则正是她所要寻找的宝剑。
据说铁匠为了寻找材料来完成宝剑的最后一道工序，
只身前去挑战巨龙并为此丢掉了性命。
随后更是有哥布林企图趁机夺走宝剑。
名叫蓝天的小女孩独自留守在家，十分害怕。
玛琪拉菲菈便开始想办法让小女孩安心。
episodes.summaryEn:
Maglielle arrives safely at the blademaster's home
in Skywyrm Valley only to find the blademaster's
daughter—a young girl named Blue—clutching the
Sentinel of the Sky: The sword owed to Maglielle.
According to Blue, her father was slain by a dragon
while collecting sword materials. With his demise,
goblins are now emboldened to steal the sword.
Maglielle promises Blue to make everything right.

episodes.summaryZh:
通过契约书拿到了宝剑的玛琪拉菲菈
成功地战胜了带来危险的巨龙和哥布林。
风暴停息后，弗尔卡自卫团也乘救援艇前来。
蓝天最终听从了一行的建议，
与自卫团一同前往弗尔卡居住。
玛琪拉菲菈则就宝剑向万事屋谢洛提出了一个请求。
episodes.summaryEn:
Blue gives Maglielle the sword, thus completing
the sale long set in motion. For her part, Maglielle
slays the dragon and goblins that torment Blue. The
winds die down shortly after, allowing a ship helmed
by the Folca Defense Corps to land. Living alone in
the valley is too dangerous for Blue; the Corps will
shelter her in Folca. Meanwhile, Maglielle asks
Sierokarte to make enhancements to the sword.

episodes.summaryZh:
在万事屋谢洛的帮助下，
宝剑终于通过最后一道锻造工序完成了最终的强化。
玛琪拉菲菈则将这把剑交给了其原本的主人蓝天。
蓝天抱着相当于父亲遗物的宝剑，
发誓将来一定要成为配得上这把宝剑的剑客。
episodes.summaryEn:
Thanks to the services of the Knickknack Shack,
the Sentinel of the Sky achieves its ultimate form.
Maglielle then returns the blade to its original
owner, Blue. Wielding the memento of her father in
her hand, Blue vows to become a warrior worthy of
the sword.

episodes.summaryZh:
贝阿朵丽丝为了独占功劳，
只身挑战恶势力团伙“熊孩子”却不幸落败。
为了挽回这一切，
她提议并执行了以自己为诱饵的清剿行动。
只不过对贝阿朵丽丝而言，逆境也是良机。
与敌人一同沐浴弗拉梅克攻击的贝阿朵丽丝失去了意识，
但她的剑却也因此变得更加锋利。
episodes.summaryEn:
Beatrix—in her quest for glory—tried and failed to
take down the Odajumoki Gang on her own. But turning
adversity into a boon is Beatrix's bread and butter;
to make amends for her folly, she lures the gang into
a trap, putting both them and herself in the path of
Flamek Thunder's lightning. As she sizzles in pain,
the glow of her sword intensifies.

episodes.summaryZh:
那一天失去一切的愤怒永远无法忘记。
贝阿朵丽丝出身于贵族家庭，
尽管生活有些拮据，却也有着无忧无虑的童年。
然而一切却都被凶徒所夺走，
一家人惨遭杀害，只有贝阿朵丽丝幸免于难。
要严于律己，宽以待人——
父亲的教导被她深埋于心底，
在愤恨的驱使下，少女发誓要复仇。
episodes.summaryEn:
Born to nobility, Beatrix enjoyed an idyllic life
until cutthroats raided the manor and massacred
her family and attendants. With loss and rage
indelibly seared into her memories, she struggles
to reconcile her father's motto, which champions
kindness, with her growing hatred as it warps into
a twisted vow for revenge.

episodes.summaryZh:
贝阿朵丽丝回想着家道中落后的遭遇。
尽管有人因其失去贵族身份而前来刁难，
贝阿朵丽丝却从未恨过这些人，
因为她认为这都是那些夺走其一切的凶徒所致。
在得知凶徒是“组织”的敌人——“敌对势力”的一员后，
贝阿朵丽丝毅然决定加入“组织”。
不仅是为报仇雪恨，
更是为了立下功劳夺回家族昔日的荣耀。
episodes.summaryEn:
Beatrix falls into austerity after her family's
murder. She ignores the denigrators reveling in
her ruin—the men who stole everything from her are
the ones truly deserving of her hatred. One day,
she learns those men belong to the Foe, nemesis of
the Society. Thus Beatrix joins the Society,
pushing herself to climb the organization's ladder
to achieve her ultimate goal of revenge.

episodes.summaryZh:
贝阿朵丽丝在希德霍姆散步时
偶然发现宪兵们行色匆匆的身影。
若是能在这整个泽卡里都算得上大国的花都立下功劳，
想必能提升其在“组织”里的评价。
想到这里，贝阿朵丽丝走向宪兵表示自己可以提供帮助。
episodes.summaryEn:
While roaming through Seedhollow, Beatrix comes
across some flustered guards. Sensing a chance to
raise her profile with Zega's major political power—
and in turn move up within the Society—she
approaches the guards with an offer to help.

episodes.summaryZh:
贝阿朵丽丝根据宪兵们的要求抓住了一部分
隐藏在城中的教团势力“刃重众”，
却因没能彻底粉碎对方的阴谋而感到不满。
为了拿出让自己满意的成果，
贝阿朵丽丝开始追查刃重众的踪迹。
episodes.summaryEn:
Beatrix successfully captures several members of
the Sword Veil who had infiltrated Seedhollow. The
guards who'd accepted her help are happy with the
results, but Beatrix's failure to corral all of the Veil
gnaws at her. She decides to give chase.

episodes.summaryZh:
独自调查的贝阿朵丽丝很快就断了线索。
此时同为“组织”成员的塞达和巴萨拉卡出现，
他们猜出贝阿朵丽丝遇到了麻烦，
便提出愿意帮忙。
然而贝阿朵丽丝固执地选择了拒绝。
episodes.summaryEn:
Beatrix's solo investigation into the escaped Veil
members comes to a dead end. Fellow Society agents
Zeta and Vaseraga sense that Beatrix is struggling
with something and offer their assistance. However,
Beatrix stubbornly refuses their help.

episodes.summaryZh:
一行在达利遗迹群战胜星晶兽艾卡利翁后
终于得以稍作喘息，
但贝阿朵丽丝却对已经撤退的刃重众尤为在意。
她认为是自己的失败连累大家被伏击，
进而导致巨大的星晶兽被唤醒，
而这一切都是因为自己想要独占功劳。
深刻反省之后，贝阿朵丽丝决心放下自己的坚持和面子。
episodes.summaryEn:
After a hard-fought battle, the crew sees the primal
beast Excavallion laid low. As Beatrix stares at the
hulking beast, she's consumed with guilt: Not
only had the fugitive Sword Veil launched an
ambush, they also awakened the gargantuan
primal that nearly killed the crew—two indirect
consequences of her selfish quest for glory. She
vows to drop her ego and turn over a new leaf.

episodes.summaryZh:
反省后的贝阿朵丽丝提出
追击刃重众以清除后顾之忧。
塞达、巴萨拉卡和尤斯提斯三人
看到为此低头的贝阿朵丽丝，
决定协助她完成这次任务。
episodes.summaryEn:
Beatrix finally confides in Zeta, Vaseraga, and
Eustace about what she's been up to. She begs them
to help her pursue the fleeing Sword Veil members
in order to prevent future ambushes. Bemused by
Beatrix's uncharacteristic show of humility, her
comrades agree to lend their support.

episodes.summaryZh:
贝阿朵丽丝一行找到了刃重众的踪迹
并终于将其击败。
接连的失败让刃重众副官图伦和拉玛拉索娜陷入了绝境。
他们愿意为了一族而死，
但贝阿朵丽丝却微笑着向他们伸出了手。
episodes.summaryEn:
Beatrix and her Society companions corner the
fleeing Sword Veil squad in Dahli and subdue them
in battle. Two Sword Veil adjutants, Trulen and
Ramlahsona, prepare to give their lives to protect
their clan's pride. But instead of rendering death,
Beatrix amicably extends an olive branch.

episodes.summaryZh:
一行在与袭击希德霍姆城的教团交战期间
并未见到刃重众的身影。
尤斯提斯感叹是先前的追击成功削弱了刃重众的战力，
贝阿朵丽丝则认为刃重众是因为她的选择
而退出这一战，于是默默表示了感谢。
episodes.summaryEn:
As the crew breaks through Avia's siege of
Seedhollow Castle, they notice a distinct lack of
Sword Veil troops. Eustace presumes their earlier
clashes in Dahli whittled down the Veil's forces,
but Beatrix silently wonders if the Veil withdrew
out of respect for letting them go. She whispers
her gratitude to the absent warriors.

episodes.summaryZh:
尤斯提斯在营救被恶势力团伙“熊孩子”囚禁的
贝阿朵丽丝时结识了一同行动的。
身为“组织”的特工，尤斯提斯从未对任务有过怨言，
却唯独无法接受抹杀苍之少女一行的任务。
原来善良而温暖的一行
早已在相处之中打开了尤斯提斯曾经紧闭的心扉。
episodes.summaryEn:
Society agent Eustace first met  during
an operation to rescue Beatrix from the Odajumoki
Gang. He would go on to spend more time with the
welcoming crew; in time, that was enough to thaw
his frozen heart. This became evident when the
always obedient agent defied his employer's order
to eliminate .

episodes.summaryZh:
尤斯提斯向组织提交了一份报告，
报告的内容是关于来自月之世界的神秘存在——机神。
然而报告却被“组织”彻底从记录中抹除，
尤斯提斯也因此对“组织”产生了怀疑。
面对“组织”的高层领导罗南，
尤斯提斯将自己今后立场的选择权交给了对方。
最终，尤斯提斯未因先前违背命令而受到处罚，
也得以继续与一行同行。
episodes.summaryEn:
Eustace confronts Ronan, a man belonging to
the Society's top brass. Eustace's suspicions were
roused when his field report on automagods—
mysterious weapons from the moon—was
erased by the Society, and he questions whether
he should remain loyal to the organization. Forced
by Eustace to make a choice, Ronan reluctantly
agrees to pull what strings he can, allowing
Eustace to continue journeying with the crew.

episodes.summaryZh:
尤斯提斯出生于一个雪国的小村庄，
然而突如其来的强光却夺走了属于他的安宁。
村子转瞬间就化作了废墟，
尤斯提斯的右眼也被灼伤。
失去一切的尤斯提斯茫然地在雪原徘徊之际，
是“组织”的指挥官罗南救下了他。
后来在机缘巧合下，尤斯提斯才踏上了如今的旅途。
如此想来，自己似乎也并不是十分不幸。
episodes.summaryEn:
Born to a tiny village in a snowy land, Eustace's
peaceful childhood was abruptly ended by a searing
flash of light. The light permanently burned his
right eye, and it instantly destroyed his village.
Collapsing in the snow from despair and exhaustion,
he was found and taken in by Ronan, marking his
start with the Society. Despite the tragedy of his
past, Eustace sees a silver lining: Those fateful
events led him on a journey filled with new bonds.

episodes.summaryZh:
来自“组织”的联络打破了
尤斯提斯在拂风小镇弗尔卡的悠闲时光。
原来有人在泽卡窃听了“组织”的通信。
而尤斯提斯此次的任务，
就是找出并抓捕这位窃听者。
episodes.summaryEn:
Relaxing in Folca with a good book, Eustace's
reading time is interrupted when his transceiver
rings. The Society is assigning him a new mission—
he is to identify and capture an unknown party in
Zega who is intercepting Society transmissions.

episodes.summaryZh:
据制作传声机的罗兰所说，
他最近弄丢了一个试验机。
此时尤斯提斯又听说“星神会”有着能发声的道具，
便决定参加他们的集会以调查线索。
尤斯提斯故意用手头的传声机向“组织”进行了汇报，
若是星神会窃听到了这次通信，
也许就能为问题的解决提供一个切入点。
episodes.summaryEn:
During Eustace's investigation, Rolan mentions
that his transceiver prototype has gone missing.
At a bar, Eustace overhears members of the Primeval
Acolytes claiming to hear the gods' voices through
a mysterious device and decides to attend one of
their gatherings. Before the sermon starts, Eustace
purposely reports back to the Society over his
own transceiver; since messages are being
intercepted, that could be used to his advantage.

episodes.summaryZh:
星神会的集会上，
一位名为伊扎德的男子使用的机械
疑似罗兰遗失的传声机，
他还以亲切的态度与尤斯提斯搭话。
尤斯提斯猜不出伊扎德话中的深意，
也无法证实他是否就是目标，
便决定再观察一段时间。
episodes.summaryEn:
A man named Izzard leads the Primeval Acolytes'
sermon. Toward the end, he reveals a device that
greatly resembles Rolan's missing transceiver.
Izzard greets Eustace with open arms after the
sermon. Suspicious of Izzard's cordiality but
lacking evidence to formally accuse the man,
Eustace takes a wait and see approach.

episodes.summaryZh:
尤斯提斯通过传声机通信
表达了自己对“组织”的不满，
伊扎德的态度也随之发生了明显的变化。
伊扎德开始谈论起自己的梦想，
甚至道出了只有“组织”内部掌握的情报。
尤斯提斯则不露声色地倾听着，
等待伊扎德露出马脚。
episodes.summaryEn:
Eustace tells Vaseraga via transceiver that he's
fed up with the Society. When Eustace speaks with
Izzard at the next gathering, Izzard is in unusually
high spirits. He gushes about his ideals, touching
on subjects known only to Society members. Once
again, Eustace feigns ignorance until he can
conclusively expose Izzard.

episodes.summaryZh:
互相试探之中，伊扎德终于按捺不住，
坦白自己曾是“组织”一员的真相。
伊扎德渴望通过强大的力量来指引世人的思想。
窃听到尤斯提斯不愿与“组织”为伍的言论后，
伊扎德打算拉他入伙。
只不过，那次通信其实是尤斯提斯抛出的诱饵，
得知这是一个圈套的伊扎德也立刻变了脸。
episodes.summaryEn:
Tired of playing cat and mouse with Eustace,
Izzard admits he's an ex-Society operative whose
goal is to amass enough power to reform the world.
He's been monitoring Eustace's comms and is aware
of the agent's disillusionment with the Society.
Izzard urges him to join his cause, but Eustace
dashes those hopes—the intercepted transmissions
have been bluffs from the start.

episodes.summaryZh:
得知上当的伊扎德愤怒地召唤出死灵，
却敌不过拥有弗拉梅克的尤斯提斯。
伊扎德诉说着他那不切实际的梦想，
最终也只得瘫坐在地承认自己的失败。
episodes.summaryEn:
Enraged at falling into Eustace's trap, Izzard
summons the undead to kill the agent, but they're
no match for Eustace and his trusty partner Flamek
Thunder. Even in defeat, Izzard refuses to abandon
his impossible dream.

episodes.summaryZh:
伊扎德的真实身份曝光，星神会也随之瓦解。
破罐子破摔的伊扎德承认
包括他的家人在内，他所说的一切都是谎言。
尤斯提斯回想起伊扎德曾说过他家里有只黏人的小狗，
为了确认真相，尤斯提斯来到了伊扎德虚假的家。
episodes.summaryEn:
Izzard's true colors are exposed for all members
of the Primeval Acolytes to see as he rants and
raves about fabricating his own family. Recalling
that Izzard had mentioned owning a dog, Eustace
decides to visit the scoundrel's home to confirm.

episodes.summaryZh:
芙劳自懂事起就始终沐浴在人们强烈的情感之下——
恶意与善意、欲望与嫉妒……
某日芙劳为了让自己冷静一番而来到郊外的花田——
然而无论她如何想要摆脱，
都拦不住那些恶意如一根根刺扎向内心。
唯有她的挚友莉欧斯会带给芙劳救赎。
episodes.summaryEn:
Wrath, obsession, greed, envy. Fraux is hounded by
the ugliest sides of humanity wherever she goes.
Assailed again by hurtful slights, she flees to a
flower field outside of her town to ease the
pain, but to no avail. But Fraux's best friend, Rios,
offers a gentle hand that saves her from darkness.

episodes.summaryZh:
芙劳收到了一个十分可疑的请求。
她无法放得下眼前那些有困难的人，
便答应帮对方夺回被魔物侵占的据点。
芙劳如约消灭了所有的魔物，
却不幸落入了对方准备的深坑。
原来一切都是对方心怀怨恨之下准备的陷阱。
被欺骗的愤怒让芙劳几乎失去了理智，
但她仍凭借远超常人的力量跳出了深坑
并狠狠地教训了对方所有人。
episodes.summaryEn:
A frantic man begs Fraux to exterminate monsters
in his gang's hideout. Despite the clear red flags,
she can't bring herself to ignore his earnest plea
for help. She makes good on her promise, only to
be rewarded with a double cross—the man had been
contracted by another party that wished to bury
Fraux. However, she escapes the trap and defeats
the gang soundly.

episodes.summaryZh:
芙劳将自己受骗的经历告诉了莉欧斯。
为了让陷入沮丧的芙劳振作起来，
莉欧斯邀请她去看流星雨。
二人躺在山丘上仰望星空，
却怎么也不见流星划过。
对此，莉欧斯灿然一笑并将手伸向了星空——
而后突然在芙劳身上挠来挠去逗其笑出了声。
感受到挚友的用意，芙劳由衷地表示了感谢。
episodes.summaryEn:
Fraux grouses to Rios about the aggravating event
she experienced earlier that day. Hoping to lift
Fraux's spirits, Rios suggests they go watch a
star shower supposedly happening that night.
Sprawling out atop a hill, they await a cosmic show
that ultimately never comes. Undeterred, Rios
pretends to grab a star from the sky and gifts it
to Fraux in the form of a tickle attack, their
blissful laughter echoing into the night.

episodes.summaryZh:
挚友莉欧斯突然销声匿迹。
失去了唯一的挚友，备受打击的芙劳陷入了绝望。
此时，芙劳的耳边响起了诱惑的低语。
低语的源头是自称“恶魔”的星晶兽——
也是企图创造新世界的阿卡姆系列之一。
芙劳对没有挚友的这个世界感到绝望，
于是选择了帮助“恶魔”实施计划……
而后开始与一行接触。
episodes.summaryEn:
Fraux is devastated upon learning that Rios has
gone missing. From the deafening silence comes the
sweet voice of temptation belonging to The Devil,
a primal beast of the Arcarum. Now in a world
bereft of her beloved friend, Fraux is swayed to
join The Devil's cause, which leads to her encounter
with  and the crew.

episodes.summaryZh:
与一行的邂逅，
让芙劳得以悬崖勒马。
来自伙伴的关怀让芙劳倍感愧疚。
整理思绪间，似曾相识的歌声使其停下了脚步。
那是莉欧斯以前经常哼唱的歌。
燃起了一线希望的芙劳跑向歌声传来的方向，
却发现歌声的源头并非其正在寻找的挚友……
而是一位名为萨蒂的女性。
举手投足间的细节让芙劳发现，
萨蒂并不是腿脚不好——而是眼睛看不到任何光明。
episodes.summaryEn:
Thanks to the crew's friendship, Fraux manages to
step back from the brink of despair, but this also
saddles her with newfound anxiety. While taking a
walk, a familiar song catches her attention, one
that Rios often sang. Hoping against hope, Fraux
follows the voice only to find a girl named Satie.
Judging by the girl's deliberate gait, Fraux
deduces that Satie is blind.

episodes.summaryZh:
得知萨蒂目不能视后，
芙劳就经常前去帮她操持家务。
作为回报，芙劳会要求萨蒂为其唱歌。
被歌声打动的芙劳向萨蒂提议去小镇上唱歌，
萨蒂却因羞于在人群中演唱而婉拒。
芙劳虽然为自己在萨蒂身上寻找旧友的影子而感到愧疚，
却又对萨蒂不经意间的善意感到舒心。
episodes.summaryEn:
Fraux begins helping Satie with various errands in
exchange for the occasional song. Deeply touched
by Satie's singing, Fraux urges her to sing in
town, but the timid girl declines. The warmth of
Satie's friendship is undeniably comforting, but
as the two spend more time together, Fraux feels a
growing darkness in her heart—she fears she's
using Satie to fill the hole left by Rios.

episodes.summaryZh:
芙劳收到了萨蒂的来信。
萨迪在信里告诉芙劳，
她决定去镇上唱歌，所以希望芙劳能陪她一起。
然而到了那一天，萨蒂却迟迟没有出现。
曾经那段不好的回忆让芙劳急忙前去寻找，
最终找到了差点被哥布林袭击的萨蒂。
萨蒂的歌声鼓舞了芙劳，助其击败了所有哥布林。
而后芙劳背着腿上受伤的萨蒂
火急火燎地前去寻找医生。
episodes.summaryEn:
Fraux receives a letter from Satie inviting her to
attend her debut singing performance in town, but
when the promised day arrives, Satie fails to show.
Gripped by a sinking feeling of déjà vu, Fraux sets
off in search of Satie and finds her waylaid by
goblins. The Evoker dispatches the monsters and
carries the injured girl to a doctor.

episodes.summaryZh:
为萨蒂受伤一事而感到自责的芙劳
向萨蒂坦白了一切。
无论是芙劳在萨蒂身上寻找莉欧斯的影子，
还是其一直以来都难以和他人融洽相处。
听了芙劳一直以来的心声之后，萨蒂表示感同身受。
二人自此也成为了真正的知心好友。
episodes.summaryEn:
Feeling responsible for Satie's injury, Fraux comes
clean about her reasons for doting on the girl—how
it relates to Rios, as well as her own inability
to make friends. Satie listens quietly. When all
is said and done, the heart-to-heart brings the
pair even closer.

episodes.summaryZh:
萨蒂的歌声清澈而有穿透力。
尽管一曲唱罢也没有一人愿意驻足……
萨蒂也为自己鼓足勇气的尝试而感到骄傲。
对此，芙劳终于摆脱了内心的愧疚，
紧紧地握住了这位给予她勇气的挚友的手。
episodes.summaryEn:
Satie's song rings beautiful and clear through the
town, but not a single person stops to listen.
Despite the disappointing reception, Satie takes
pride in surmounting her anxiety to sing in public.
Inspired by Satie's courage, Fraux banishes the
darkness from her heart and takes a firm hold of
the outstretched hand offered by her new friend.

episodes.titleEn: At the End of the World
episodes.summaryZh:
一位老婆婆向二人走来并希望萨迪再唱一首。
陆陆续续地，周围传来了更多返场再唱的请求。
萨蒂的歌声最终打动了小镇的居民。
不绝于耳的掌声让沉浸在歌声余韵中的芙劳
决定尝试相信他人。
episodes.summaryEn:
An elderly woman steps forward, asking Satie for
an encore. A ring of cheering townsfolk soon forms
around Fraux and Satie, no doubt enchanted by the
girl's song. Still overcome by Satie's melody and
buoyed by the thunderous applause, Fraux breaks
into a smile, ready to give people another chance.

episodes.summaryZh:
定榫……乃维持世界之形的力量。
为了讲述自身本质，
菲迪埃尔道出了其意识深处所铭刻的那“原初之愿”。
然而如今的人类难以理解这些话语的真意……
面对不解的众人，
菲迪埃尔决定向特异点降下试炼
以判断其是否有资格知晓这空之世界的历史。
在特异点成功完成试炼之后，
菲迪埃尔终于开始讲述今时与往昔的真相。
episodes.summaryEn:
Wedges are the pressures that preserve the world's
form. Fediel is one such wedge, and standing before
her is a mortal—the singularity—who struggles to
comprehend the meaning of the wedge's existence
and prayer. To gauge if the singularity is worthy
of knowing the world's history, she issues a trial,
which the young skyfarer overcomes.

episodes.summaryZh:
对于拥有永恒时光的龙而言，
空之世界的生命过于纤弱与短暂。
然而生命倾尽全力活过自己一生的意念
最终都回归世界并流入定榫的意识之中。
也许是因为拥有语言，
“人类”的意念从众多生命中脱颖而出，
在空之世界留下了浓墨重彩的印记。
残存于世的定榫也正是因此
才会多使用人类姿态的化身。
episodes.summaryEn:
Mortal lives are but a fleeting flicker in the eyes
of essentially eternal dragons. But even as those
ephemeral sparks return to ash, their memories and
emotions weave a grander tapestry that blankets
the wedges and the skies. It is perhaps due to this
influence that many of the remaining wedges adopt
forms resembling the children of man.

episodes.summaryZh:
在世界的某个角落——无人也无魔物之地……
为了消灭力量足以毁灭世界的特异点，
名为“林德沃姆”的真龙发出了苏醒后的咆哮。
那是一场倾世之战，世界尽头也为之震颤，
身为空之定榫的六龙也因此被唤醒。
episodes.summaryEn:
In a sky devoid of mortals and monsters, the true
dragon Lindwurm wakes with a thunderous howl.
Sensing that the singularity has grown powerful
enough to affect the world's trajectory, the dragon
appears before the mortal child to pass judgment.
The battle's shockwaves reverberate throughout the
skies, and the Six Dragons awaken not long after.

episodes.summaryZh:
在其苏醒的十多年前，
一对配偶与小红龙为了让各地的星晶兽回归本源
而带领着骑空团奔波于一片片空域。
然而旅途之中，那对配偶因不愿牺牲小红龙
而选择向空之神发起挑战。
二人在反抗神明的旅途中，诞下了一个婴孩。
男子于是孤身前去挑战空之神。
那场恶战的最后——男子终于赢得了胜利，
可被空之神附身的女子却失去了踪影……
于是男子将孩子和小红龙一同留在故乡的小岛，
此后便为了寻回爱妻而踏上了前往伊斯塔鲁西亚的旅途。
episodes.summaryEn:
Years before Fediel's awakening, a skyfaring dyad led
a mission to restore primal beasts to their original
states. During their journey, the sky god demanded
the sacrifice of their red dragon companion. The
skyfarers refused, defeating the god in battle. But
with victory came loss—the half of the dyad who
served as a shrine priestess was spirited away. To
save the love of his life, the remaining half of the
dyad left their newborn child and the Red Dragon in
the care of his hometown and set off for Estalucia.

episodes.summaryZh:
在其苏醒的大约五百年前，
被后世称作霸空战争的战火将世界隔断。
空之民与星之民的实力差距一目了然。
人们都以为那会是一场单方面的蹂躏。
可一个接一个的奇迹却让空之民逐渐扭转了局势，
直至最终将星之民逐出空之世界。
episodes.summaryEn:
Five hundred years before Fediel's awakening, the
conflict that would become known as the War raged
between skydwellers and Astrals. All presumed the
superior Astrals would claim a decisive victory,
but the disadvantaged skydwellers were blessed
with miracle upon miracle, allowing them to
finally expel the Astrals from the Sky Realm.

episodes.summaryZh:
在其苏醒的大约一千五百年前，
苍之少女被创造了出来。
原来创世神的半身——星之神从前就有一个夙愿。
那就是融合空之神的力量，以此恢复创世神应有的姿态。
为此，星之神的子民创造了用于高效回收力量的容器。
那就是苍之少女。
episodes.summaryEn:
Fifteen hundred years before Fediel's awakening,
the Astral god—the half of the Omnipotent that
fled to the stars—vowed to seize the sky god's
power in a bid to reclaim its original form. It
required a vessel to store the sky's power, and
so the Girl in Blue was created.

episodes.summaryZh:
在其苏醒的大约两千年前，
为了寻回被迫分裂出的半身，
星之神向空之世界发起了进攻。
星之民的入侵势不可挡。
他们势如破竹般征服了相对落后的空之世界。
episodes.summaryEn:
Two thousand years before Fediel's awakening, the
Astral god invaded the Sky Realm to reunite with
its missing half. Caught off guard by the Astral
forces, the skies were summarily conquered.

episodes.summaryZh:
在其苏醒的大约六千年前，
古代空之民十分畏惧创世神巴哈姆特，
他们称巴哈姆特为巨大的怪物。
后来，人类向神明宣战……
被打败的创世神则被撕裂为两个半身。
其中一半化作“司掌破坏与再生的巴哈姆特”
隐匿于空之世界的某个角落……
另一半则化作“司掌创造的巴哈姆特”飞向星海。
episodes.summaryEn:
Six thousand years before Fediel's awakening, a
faction of ancient skydwellers had come to fear
their god, the Omnipotent. The children of man
turned their blades against the divine dragon, and
the stricken being was rent in twain. One half
became Bahamut, master of destruction and rebirth,
who vanished into the blue skies; one half became
Bahamut, master of creation, who ascended into the
sea of stars.

episodes.summaryZh:
其苏醒之时向前倒推大约七千年，
放眼望去，是一片满目疮痍的废土世界。
被后世称为创世神的巨龙巴哈姆特
通过破灭终局的力量毁灭了原本遭到污染的世界。
巴哈姆特将尚未受到污染的极少数世界碎片隔离在空中，
使其化作悬浮于空中的岛屿。
空之世界就此诞生。
episodes.summaryEn:
Seven thousand years before Fediel's awakening,
the world laid in ruins. It was around this time
that Bahamut—a colossal dragon also known as the
Omnipotent—delivered untold destruction to cleanse
the contaminated world, and it cast what little
untainted land remained into the skies. This was
how the Sky Realm and its floating islands came to
be.

episodes.summaryZh:
其苏醒之时向前倒推大约三万年。
被毁灭的大地之上，在那遥远的地平线尽头，
人类顽强地延续着火种并复兴着文明的力量。
同一时期——昔日逃往夜天的人类
也在那里缔造了繁荣的文明。
两个世界之间的文明竞争愈演愈烈，最终演变为战争。
旷日持久的战争让世界再度毁灭。
又过了两万三千年后……
受命复苏世界的“能够独立思考的存在”从长眠中苏醒，
为实现人类的夙愿而展翅飞向天空。
episodes.summaryEn:
30,000 years before Fediel's awakening, mankind
united amid decayed lands, taking steps to restore
their shattered civilization to glory. Meanwhile,
those who had fled to the cosmos had made giant
leaps rebuilding their society. Both of these
worlds collided out of hubris, resulting in the
earthen world's destruction once more. 23,000 years
passed before a great dragon spread its wings and
rose to the occasion of reviving the world.
